summary: Modine Manufacturing closed the spin-off of its Performance Technologies business and combined it with Gentherm via a Reverse Morris Trust on October 1, 2026. Modine distributed one SpinCo share per Modine share to holders of record on September 28, 2026; SpinCo then paid Modine a $155,991,275 cash distribution, reduced by an exchange ratio adjustment from the $210,000,000 initially agreed. The filing also discloses executive changes and related agreements. The structure uses a merger sub, with Gentherm as acquirer; SpinCo shareholders' final ownership split and post-closing working capital adjustment remain key arb considerations around deal mechanics and valuation.
